name: Baked Shrimp, Broccoli, Zucchini, Garlic & Feta Medley with Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half rounds. Add to the baking sheet with the broccoli.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the baking sheet, reserving a small amount for garnish.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the baking sheet along with shrimp and spices; toss to combine.
Cut butter into small pieces. Sprinkle feta over the shrimp and veggies; dot with butter.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until veggies are tender and shrimp is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide shrimp and veggies between plates. Top with reserved parsley and pine nuts. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
